name: Omafocus
author: Bruno
description: Omafocus timer in the Omarchy bar: pick a focus or break duration from the panel, run a countdown, and get a desktop notification with a chime when time is up.

barWidget.description: Start, pause and reset a focus timer. The bar shows the remaining time; the panel lets you pick the duration and is notified with a sound when it finishes.

schema.label: Focus (minutes)
schema.description: Default duration of a focus session.

schema.label: Short break (minutes)
schema.description: Default duration of a short break.

schema.label: Long break (minutes)
schema.description: Default duration of a long break.

schema.label: Default mode
schema.description: Which mode a new timer starts in.

schema.label: Play sound when time is up
schema.description: Play a chime in addition to the desktop notification.
